capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: OpenEV Data lists 82 kWh gross for the 2025 Long Range AWD/Performance and the existing 2026 Performance-B record; 2027 US model assumed unchanged (no pack change reported). Unproven for 2027: no 2027-specific pack page found; carried over because no pack change was reported between 2026 and 2027.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: OpenEV Data lists 79 kWh net for the same pack in 2025/2026; carried over to 2027. Wikipedia says the Performance Juniper pack is ~82-84 kWh usable (LG 5M), so the Performance figure may be low. Unproven for 2027: no 2027-specific pack page found; carried over because no pack change was reported between 2026 and 2027.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: OpenEV Data: NMC for the 2025/2026 Long Range AWD / Performance; Wikipedia: nickel-based NMC. Unproven for 2027: no 2027-specific pack page found; carried over because no pack change was reported between 2026 and 2027.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: OpenEV Data: 400v for the same pack.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Teslabs (2025-01) says no manual battery-preconditioning control exists, only navigating to a charger; EV Database listings say the battery is warmed automatically when navigating to a charger. Tesla manuals were not fetchable (403). Navigation preconditioning is an over-the-air software feature across Tesla models; Teslabs gives no model years. Tesla manuals were not readable (403). A Scheduled Precondition and Charge setting exists (seen in search excerpts of the Model Y manual), and one June 2025 Teslabs comment (Model 3) says the app can start battery warming with a Supercharger selected; no Tesla page shows a dedicated manual battery-preconditioning control, so automatic_with_navigation is kept.

Estimated: Listing for the same model family says preconditioning is possible and starts automatically when navigating to a charger. Combined with the Teslabs no-manual-control statement. Tesla manuals were not readable (403). dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: OpenEV Data 250 kW for the same pack; Wikipedia 250 kW for Premium/Performance. Unproven for 2027: no 2027-specific pack page found; carried over because no pack change was reported between 2026 and 2027.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Thechargeport puts the non-Standard Model Y trims at the 11.5 kW end of the 7.7-11.5 kW range (North America); Wikipedia: up to 11.5 kW AC on all variants. EU listings quote 11 kW 3-phase, not used.
Estimated: Wikipedia: all Model Y variants support up to 11.5 kW AC.
